class.name: HUDServer
class.description: The one owner of the HUD's state: which of its panels are open, the HUD shown at all, and the vehicle whose card is open. The HUD's scenes draw this state and ask for its changes here - a menu, a close button, a key, a script ([code]maszyna.hud[/code]) alike. The server knows no panel of its own: a panel is a name the HUD gives it.

method.name: card_get_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle whose card is open, an invalid [RID] for none.

method.name: card_open
method.description: The card of the vehicle; one already open shows this vehicle instead. The card of a freed vehicle closes.

method.name: hud_set_visible
method.description: The HUD shown or hidden as a whole (e.g. while a scenery loads).

method.name: panel_is_visible
method.description: Whether the panel is open; a panel never set is closed.

method.name: panel_toggle
method.description: The panel opened when closed, closed when open.

signal.name: card_changed
signal.description: The card shows another vehicle; an invalid [RID] when it closed.

signal.name: hud_visibility_changed
signal.description: The HUD was shown or hidden.

signal.name: panel_visibility_changed
signal.description: The panel was opened or closed.
